core_question: Do biologically different source states alter bacterial-cellulose formation through a common measurable interface/microenvironment state, or through source-specific molecules or scaffolds that retain effects after those mediators are matched?

cross_domain_architecture.non_collapse_rule: The soluble-state channels and the structural-scaffold channel are distinct causal routes and may not be treated as one mechanism without direct evidence.

adversarial_competing_models.prediction: Different source classes converge toward similar BC phenotypes once the portable state vector is matched.
A residual BC effect remains after mediator matching and is reproduced by a defined source-specific molecule across independent BC batches.
Milk-associated changes are reproduced by defined lactose/protein/lipid/glycan analog composition without donor or infant-sex provenance.
Most placental-material effect is reproduced by characterized dECM alone and does not require paired milk.
Infant-sex association disappears after lactation-stage, donor and measured composition controls.

preregistered_cross_test.name: STATE_VECTOR_COLLAPSE_TEST
preregistered_cross_test.principle: Compare source classes only after measuring or matching the portable state vector; then test whether source-label residuals remain.
preregistered_cross_test.prediction_A: If source-label differences collapse after mediator matching, do not promote source identity as causal.
preregistered_cross_test.prediction_B: If a reproducible residual survives mediator matching, isolate and test a defined factor or structural property.
preregistered_cross_test.prediction_C: If a defined factor reproduces the residual direction across independent BC batches while generic controls do not, promote only the factor-level mechanism.
preregistered_cross_test.prediction_D: If matched and mismatched donor placenta-milk pairings converge after direct composition matching, pairing provenance is not a causal materials mechanism.

high_value_bridge_candidates.pregnancy_lactation_side: human milk contains interface-active proteins and lipid structures; infant-sex and lactation-stage associations may affect some protein abundances but do not define a universal class
high_value_bridge_candidates.extremophile_side: LEA-family proteins provide a candidate interface-active recovery factor

high_value_bridge_candidates.pregnancy_lactation_side: milk carbohydrate and osmolality profiles are direct measurable variables
high_value_bridge_candidates.extremophile_side: trehalose is a major recovery-associated compatible-solute confound/candidate

high_value_bridge_candidates.pregnancy_lactation_side: protein/lipid interfacial layers can alter physical interface behavior
high_value_bridge_candidates.extremophile_side: defined protein/interface effects can alter the same air-liquid boundary

kill_rules: If direct composition and interface matching remove the source-class BC difference, reject source-label causality for that phenotype.
If a generic protein or trehalose control reproduces a PvLEA4-associated phenotype, reject PvLEA4 specificity.
If defined milk-analog composition reproduces a donor-milk phenotype, do not attribute the effect to fetal sex or pregnancy provenance without an additional residual.
If dECM-only reproduces a paired placenta-milk phenotype, classify the result as a structural scaffold effect unless a paired residual remains.
If sex-associated effects fail independent-donor replication, do not retain a sex-specific materials claim.
If BC identity is not orthogonally separated from protein precipitate, mixed biomass or scaffold material, no matrix-mechanism promotion is admissible.
human_material_boundary: No operational culture of human milk or raw placenta is introduced by this artifact. Human-derived work remains institution-only under consent, ethics, biosafety, handling and disposal procedures; defined analogs and non-human controls remain the preferred first mechanistic step.
next_action: Use the existing PvLEA4/trehalose/interface gate as the first soluble-state test and treat the placenta-milk branch as a separate provenance-bound comparison in which direct composition and interface measurements precede any infant-sex or donor-pair interpretation.
